However, the Expert 'perceptual_quality_auditor' failed to detect this, likely because it is trained on standard compression/noise/blur metrics, not stylistic filters. 
The 'image_text_auditor' found that the window text 'VILLAGE' was read as 'TILLACE' (low confidence), confirming the Router's observation of text distortion/gibberish (severity 2.0). 
The 'structural_collapse' at the bottom border (severity 3.0) is also valid; the transition between the stone wall and the decorative frame is muddy and indistinct.

I will maintain the high severity for the texture anomaly as it fundamentally alters the image modality from photo to painting, hindering class verification.
